title: ITV / Channel family
slide_intent: Separate what unifies the network from what distinguishes its channels, because audiences need both a recognizable network and distinct programme destinations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen network coherence without erasing channel personality.
demonstration: Six coloured logos form two rows on a dark field: ITVX, ITV1, ITV2, ITV3, ITV4 and ITVBe. Shared ITV lettering coexists with distinct suffixes and colours.
practical_value: Separate what unifies the network from what distinguishes its channels.

content_islands.spec: ITV3, ITV4 and ITVBe complete the family.
